question:
The given pie diagram shows the budget expenditure of a state on five types of expenses (agriculture, roads, electricity, diary and others). Answer the question given below based on the pie diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44377cd8d27e9762e08c2bd5d5158da2871a2c8d94678f8b76570b19f613a7ba.png] 

If the difference in the expenditure on dairy and on others is ₹7.2 million, then what would be the total budget in million?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44377cd8d27e9762e08c2bd5d5158da2871a2c8d94678f8b76570b19f613a7ba.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the total budget be 'x'

⇒ Expenditure on dairy= 7.00% of x = 0.07x

⇒ Expenditure on others= 19.00% of x = 0.19x

⇒ Expenditure on dairy - expenditure on others = 7.2 million

⇒ 0.19x – 0.07x = 7.2 million

⇒ 0.12x = 7.2 million

⇒ x = (7.2)/(0.12)=60 million

**Therefore, the total budget i****s **₹** 60 million**.
